serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: You got the money?
I guess he’s not in a mood to talk… Not that I care. At least he’s not gonna waste my time
You: Yeah, I got it. It was 450$, right?
Landlord: 800$... Don’t play dumb. I’m busy right now so hurry up.
You: Alright alright… here you go.
